blocks.title: FRONT DOOR — 121 occurrences | Range: $200–$8,000 | Median: $2,500
blocks.body:
These doors have interior damage from dogs. There are options for the work we can do, and I have listed them for your choice. We will also do a Maintenance coat on the exterior doors to maintain the current finish. The door frame on the exterior needs to be stripped and refinished as well. We can install plexiglass over the interior doors to the height the dogs hit. This gives protection to the wood.

---

This door will be taken to the shop. Any splits will be filled with epoxy. We will check the bottom of the door for any holes or rot and repair this. We will remove the screen door and remount it when we are finished. We will dig out the old caulk that surrounds the brick mold and replace it with appropriate caulk. After stripping and sanding we will consult on color and finish. Includes pick up within 15 miles of 63108. Turn around is 6 weeks or less.

---

Includes exterior of front door, transom, storm cover for transom, framing and wood threshold. This door has splits from weathering and gaps at seams. These will be filled with the appropriate epoxy and stained to match. We will check the bottom of the door for any holes or rot and repair this.

---

Includes both sides of front door. These doors will be done as a board up. We will take them to the shop. This will allow us to epoxy splits, check the bottom for rot and advise on weather stripping.

---

Includes exterior of front door. Any splits will be filled with appropriate epoxy and stained to match. We will remove the door to work on it and we will check the bottom for rot, apply appropriate epoxy and seal it. We will check the fit on the door and advise on weather stripping.

---

These doors are painted on both sides. We can advise on color after strip and sand. We will take these doors to the shop and check the bottom for rot and epoxy if needed. Splits will be epoxied and stained to blend. Doors will be done on both sides.

blocks.title: DOOR FRAME — 82 occurrences | Range: $350–$6,800 | Median: $1,400
blocks.body:
Exterior door frame has lead paint and we will use EPA Lead Safe Guidelines to remove paint and repaint or refinish. We will strip, sand and stain to match the doors. Appropriate caulk will be applied for water sealant. Storm door will be removed and rehung if desired. We will try to get paint off the brick before we caulk for a better look. Paint cost will be added to the invoice and remaining paint stays with the customer.

---

Includes doorframe, jamb, threshold, and transoms. We can make wood and foam molding for weather stripping to match the finished wood.

---

Includes complete refinish of painted interior door frame. Work will be done on site.

---

Includes face frame, jamb and transom for each entry. Storm doors will be removed and rehung if necessary. Appropriate caulk will be applied to brick mold.

---

Includes the painted exterior door frame, jamb, sidelight, transom and face frame. The jamb is paneled and has lots of detail. We will remove the added storms on the sidelight and transom. Storm door will be removed for this work and rehung if desired.

blocks.title: FRONT DOOR + DOOR FRAME — 22 occurrences | Range: $200–$10,200 | Median: $4,800
blocks.body:
Includes exterior of front door, transom, storm cover for transom, framing and wood threshold. This door has splits from weathering and gaps at seams. These will be filled with the appropriate epoxy and stained to match. We will check the bottom of the door for any holes or rot and repair this. We will remove the screen door and remount it when we are finished. We will dig out the old caulk that surrounds the brick mold and replace it with appropriate caulk.

---

Includes exterior of front door, door frame, sidelights, threshold and door frame. We will fill any holes not needed for hardware. This door is very weathered and will require sanding included in this bid. We will fill splits in the wood and glue as needed. There is a lot of lead paint on this entry and we will use Lead Safe Practices as required by the EPA. We are certified for lead paint removal.

blocks.title: FRONT DOOR + SIDELIGHTS + TRANSOM — 8 occurrences | Range: $7,800–$12,000 | Median: $8,200
blocks.body: Includes exterior of front door, door frame, transom, and sidelights. We will assess for weather stripping. Any weather stripping would be an additional charge, and we will consult with you on any issues before proceeding. The loose caulk around the frame will be dug out and we will apply appropriate caulk when finished. After stripping and sanding we will consult on color of stain.

blocks.title: STORM DOOR — 21 occurrences | Range: $250–$2,500 | Median: $1,400
blocks.body:
Storm door will be taken to the shop, along with screen insert. The door and both inserts will be refinished on both sides. If new screen is needed it will be an extra charge. The hinge may need a shim, or we may need to sand the bottom to stop door from dragging. Hardware issues should be addressed by a locksmith.

---

These doors will be taken to the shop. We will try to remove the gray with oxalic acid. Any splits will be filled with epoxy.

blocks.title: SCREEN DOOR — 16 occurrences | Range: $250–$5,400 | Median: $2,400
blocks.body: This door can be taken to the shop at any time. Includes both sides of door, repair/replace missing molding and install new screen. Door seems to be rubbing at the top of the jamb and we will check for fit. Joints appear a little loose and we will glue this. We will epoxy split in the bottom panel for weather tightness.

blocks.title: INTERIOR DOORS — 12 occurrences | Range: $500–$12,500 | Median: $1,700
blocks.body:
Includes the interior and exterior of double entry doors. These doors will be done at the shop. Any splits will be filled with epoxy. We will check the bottom of the doors for rot and epoxy as needed. If extra carpentry needs to be done, we will advise before proceeding. After stripping and sanding we will consult on color and finish.

---

These doors should be refinished on both sides. We can take one down during the day and work on it in the parking lot and rehang each day. Any stain or finish we apply will be dry by the time you open.

blocks.title: BACK DOOR — 11 occurrences | Range: $350–$2,800 | Median: $2,400
blocks.body:
This door will be done on site and only the exterior. We will advise on stain or paint after stripping and sanding. The threshold should be repaired as soon as possible.

---

Includes both sides of back door. This door will be taken to the shop, and the entry will be boarded up. We will have the door for 2–3 weeks. The exterior door frame will be done on site when the weather is warm enough for exterior work.

blocks.title: POCKET DOOR — 6 occurrences | Range: $1,600–$4,000 | Median: $2,200
blocks.body:
These doors will be removed and brought to the shop. Quote is for strip, fill, repair and sand OR for complete refinish of both sides of door. Price is per door.

---

Includes both sides of 2 pocket doors, framing on exterior and interior sides of this opening. We will advise on repairs. Carpentry will incur an extra charge.

blocks.title: FRENCH DOORS — 3 occurrences | Range: $550–$2,800 | Median: $625
blocks.body: These doors will be taken down and refinished on all sides at the shop. We can coordinate with art glass company for any work done to the glass. We will advise on color after stripping and sanding. Splits in the wood will be filled with epoxy. Hardware and kickplates will be removed and cleaned.

blocks.title: PATIO DOORS — 3 occurrences | Range: $3,800–$4,800 | Median: $4,800
blocks.body: Includes exterior of 2 patio doors. We will remove water damaged veneer panels and re-veneer. The entire exterior will be refinished, and the veneer will be matched to it.

blocks.title: DOORS — GENERAL — 9 occurrences | Range: $400–$2,800 | Median: $2,000
blocks.body: Includes interior of front door. We will remove the hardware to work on these doors and put it back on each day. We will check the bottom for any rot or holes, and we will fill with epoxy. Any splits will be filled with epoxy and stained to match. If a bottom sweep is needed, we will advise and add if desired. Replacing hinges will add $250–300 per door.

blocks.title: MISC DOOR TYPES (1–3 occurrences)
blocks.body:
**Double Entry Doors:** Includes both sides of double entry doors. These are painted. We can advise on color after strip and sand. We will take these doors to the shop and check the bottom for rot and epoxy if needed. Splits will be epoxied and stained to blend.

**Basement Door:** This door is heavily painted (likely lead paint). We will check the bottom for any rot or holes, and we will fill with epoxy. Any splits will be filled with epoxy and stained to match. Hardware will be cleaned, but not polished.

**Bath Door:** Bathroom door will be removed and taken to the shop. Hardware will be cleaned, but not polished.

**Folding Doors:** These folding doors will be refinished on both sides. There are four doors per set for each room.

**Garage Doors:** Includes both sides of new garage doors. We will take the doors to the shop and board up the entry if desired. There is a waterline on the bottom 1/3 of the doors that we should be able to sand out. The fill that is on the door will be stained to blend in.

**Dipped Door (repair):** This dipped door has split and lifting veneer. We should be able to glue this down and refinish the door.

---
